name: shopify-accessibility-patterns
description: Theme level accessibility patterns for Shopify Online Store 2.0, with a catalogue of 32 statically detectable findings, eleven failing and corrected page pairs, and a test that asserts what the findings cannot tell you.

scripts.test: node --test test/announce.mjs test/catalogue.mjs test/checks.mjs test/contrast.mjs test/css-contract.mjs test/css.mjs test/examples.mjs test/focus-order.mjs test/gap.mjs test/html.mjs test/liquid-contract.mjs test/liquid.mjs
scripts.check: npm test && npm run verify && npm run count
